description: SFLOW explicit (A 210 2, A 220 3) with dry land next to deep water as a wall (A 221 2, A 209 0): regular waves (T 6 s, kh 1.3, 10 m deep, 24 cells per wave length) normal to a block of dry cells (T 10, 2 m above the water) at x = 196 m. The cell in front of the land keeps its non-hydrostatic pressure, the dry cell is a dq/dn = 0 wall of the pressure equation and of the pressure gradients, the normal velocity is mirrored in the divergence, and the A 220 3 term does not read the bed level of the dry cell: the standing wave has its antinode at the land (gauge at x = 195 m), the mean water level stays at zero.
covers: sflow_pjm_quad: rhs, ucorr, quad_calc, upgrad with a wall of dry land
sflow_pjm_quad::upgrad: the level of a dry cell is not read (A 220 3)
